[MidJourney 5](https://www.midjourney.com)
:::

For four days you have been asking questions about a whole table. Today you learn to ask the
same question of every part of it at once.

Day 5 owns one sentence, and you will meet it in two forms that you have to recognize as the
same sentence. The **split-apply-combine sentence** breaks a table into groups, runs a
calculation on each, and hands back one answer per group. Almost every real question about data
turns out to be that shape: not "what is the average", but "what is the average **for each**".

This afternoon you meet the questions the sentence cannot answer, and the older, slower tool
that handles them.
